story.chapter-1.intro.defaultMessage: As you stare down at your keyboard, the computer whirring in the background, an idea suddenly comes to you. You stand up and head over to your workbench... You begin working and quickly build a bot, it has two arms and hovers. Huh it works... You assign it to begin making solar panels and get to work on another.

story.chapter-1.part-2.defaultMessage: Before long you have 10 bots, but this is quickly getting tiring. You set up an assembly line and write some code that lets it produce bots for you.

story.chapter-1.part-3.defaultMessage: You're also going to need some power, so you launch some panels into space, and begin to sell off the excess power.

story.chapter-2.intro.defaultMessage: You decide that manually building assembly lines is too much work, a few moments later you decide to design an AI that can manage the creation of assembly lines for you. Before long it's ready. You insert the module into a specialized bot and it whirrs to life quickly buzzing off to begin constructing more assembly lines.

story.chapter-2.part-2.defaultMessage: You're starting to run out of space. You've set up a research division and created better AI that can collect the resources you need for your discoveries. But you need to create some servers to store all the data. Costly but worth it.

story.chapter-2.part-3.defaultMessage: Before long your empire grows beyond anything you could ever have imagined. You've long since surrounded your first star with panels and it's time to begin thinking of expansion. You send out some probes and start looking for ideal systems to take over. In the meantime you expand your operation to other planets in the system.

story.chapter-3.intro.defaultMessage: As you stare into a mirror one day, you are hit with the sudden realization of how long it's been. You design a method of extracting your consciousness and export it to an organic computer. With infinite life in your grasp you set out to explore the universe.

story.chapter-3.part-2.defaultMessage: One day you come across some kind of anomaly, your curiosity gets the better of you. You head towards it and avocado into the murky mists.. Some writing begins to take shape and you catch a glimpse of a few words: Buffer overflow imminent... 41.9Qi/42.0Qi. The number ticks over and everything goes black...

story.chapter-3.part-2-stare.defaultMessage: One day you come across some kind of anomaly, your curiosity gets the better of you. You head towards it and stare into the murky mists.. Some writing begins to take shape and you catch a glimpse of a few words: Buffer overflow imminent... 41.9Qi/42.0Qi. The number ticks over and everything goes black...

story.chapter-4.intro.defaultMessage: You find yourself staring at your workbench, having just created your first bot...

story.chapter-4.part-10.defaultMessage: 10 times.. The machine seems to be reaching its limits. Perhaps its best to focus on something new. You have noticed with each reset the anomaly has changed slightly. Perhaps it's time to focus on the secrets of the Universe.

story.chapter-4.part-2.defaultMessage: You decide to take advantage of what you have learned. Infinity doesn't seem that long after all. Altering a couple of lines in the assembly line logic allows you to produce bots at twice the rate. However before long your previous experience with this reality slips from your mind as if it were a dream. "There has to be a way to remember more" you think to yourself as you set out to find the anomaly once more.

story.chapter-4.part-3.defaultMessage: Remembering more is no easy feat and the multitimeline stuff takes its toll. You manage to triple the effect of your Managers, this bonus trickles down to your Assembly Lines too. You wonder if you can do better next time.

story.chapter-4.part-4.defaultMessage: Remembering is getting easier. This time you Quadruple the power of your servers using information you intentionally acquired from the future. And set out to improve your Data Centers next.

story.chapter-4.part-5.defaultMessage: Advanced spacial reasoning along with smaller server profiles allow you to fit far more power in the same space. Five times more to be precise.

story.chapter-4.part-6.defaultMessage: You set up an algorithm that allows you to bring large quantities of data back with you Quantum tunneling was difficult to work out but now you can send planetary designs back through time and preplan your Data Centers. Six times as efficient as your first run your entire production line is becoming a much smoother machine. How long can this go on for?

story.chapter-5.part-1.defaultMessage: As you gather the last secret a vague memory of another life begins to surface... A portal appears next to the anomaly, a new path forward. You decide it's worth the risk. There's nothing left for you here anyway.

story.chapter-5.part-2.defaultMessage: Somewhere in the distance a message seems to be looping on repeat... Temporal Anomaly located... please input instructions.

story.chapter-5.part-3.defaultMessage: You blink your eyes open and memories begin to flood back, how long were you stuck in there? You look down at your watch; what felt like many lifetimes has passed in mere minutes. You sit up and step from the makeshift platform you used for the simulator. It's difficult to stand as you become somewhat faint in your mortal form.

story.chapter-5.part-4.defaultMessage: You head over to your workstation and overlook the data. 'Simulation primed, ready to begin consumption.' You hit enter and the machine begins to consume realities much like the one you were just in. Gathering data to run even more simulations. Whatever this artifact is, you will work out what it does.

story.chapter-5.part-5.defaultMessage: While you wait you decide to start manually playing through simulations. Bit of "game time" couldn't hurt.

story.chapter-6.complete.defaultMessage: A sudden realization forms in your mind. While you thought all this time you were the one running the simulation, you have in fact been the simulation. In the distance you hear a few words as time begins to slow... "Shut it down... you know what happened last time the simulation became self aware. You're just going to have to start over."

story.chapter-6.speed.defaultMessage: The artifact slows to a crawl. You give it another tap; suddenly the words on the computer change from "Undefined" and are replaced with CPU time...

story.chapter-6.translation.defaultMessage: As the computer translates the last letter, two words show... "The Artifact" Bah! What does that even mean?! Clearly there is something missing.
